page.notes: The table's cells are separated by " | ". The marks *, ‡ in the year column and in the margin are matched by the printed signs; the note attached to the 1573 row has no printed position indicator beyond the star. "Barnholdus" is uncertain. The tail of the "Barth." note and the foot text are a continuation as printed. The "Duo posteriores" line is set in italic and centred. The printed catchword "Ioachim" appears only in bottom_margin.
